command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 tools/agents/validate_tasks.py --root tasks --strict
python3 tools/agents/check_task_policy.py --root . --strict
python3 tools/agents/workflow_evidence.py validate --root .
python3 tools/agents/check_task_state_links.py --root . --strict
python3 tools/agents/generate_session_brief.py --check
python3 tools/agents/sync_skills.py --check
python3 tools/agents/check_ara_claims.py --root . --strict
mapfile -t changed_files < <({ git diff --name-only origin/main --; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
python3 tools/docs/check_docs_sync.py --root . --files "${changed_files[@]}" --strict
python3 tools/docs/check_doc_links.py --root .
python3 tools/repo/check_root_hygiene.py --root . --strict
git diff --check
